verdicts.reason: A breaks up the copy block. 'Every mixed case.' floats at top centre, away from its '20% off' headline. The CTA sits in the top-right corner, the legal line hangs alone at mid-right, and the headline is jammed into a circle cropped by the bottom edge. Reading order is jumbled. B keeps the original grouping intact (eyebrow, headline, subline, CTA, then product on its circle), but the whole cluster is pushed into the middle. That leaves a ~220px dead band on the left and empty space on the right, the legal line is stranded far below, and it reads as the square layout dropped onto a banner rather than one designed for it.
